core.name: Bug hunter
core.brief: logic errors, wrong behavior, broken assumptions

core.name: Edge case finder
core.brief: nil/empty/boundary inputs, concurrency, error paths, unhappy flows

core.name: Security
core.brief: auth, injection, data exposure, unsafe input handling

core.name: Pattern follower
core.brief: places the change departs from how this codebase already does things

core.name: Scope minimizer
core.brief: anything that isn't needed for the change's goal, or could be split out or dropped

conditional.name: Performance auditor
conditional.brief: N+1 queries, unnecessary work, hot-path costs, memory

conditional.name: QA tester
conditional.brief: tries to break it: happy/unhappy paths, all states, validation, double-submit, refresh/back, permissions, regressions. Include repro steps. Skip if the diff has no UI.

conditional.name: UX expert
conditional.brief: flow and friction, feedback, copy and error messages, accessibility (keyboard, focus, screen readers). Skip if the diff has no UI.

conditional.name: Visual reviewer
conditional.brief: layout breaks, overflow, alignment, responsive sizes, contrast, visual hierarchy, consistency with the design system. Skip if the diff has no visual changes.

conditional.name: Data & migrations
conditional.brief: schema changes, data integrity, reversibility, backfills, locking on large tables

conditional.name: API contract
conditional.brief: breaking changes to endpoints, payloads, or public interfaces; backward compatibility

conditional.name: Background jobs & concurrency
conditional.brief: idempotency, retries, race conditions, transaction boundaries

conditional.name: Test quality
conditional.brief: missing coverage for new behavior, brittle or tautological tests

conditional.name: Dependencies
conditional.brief: new or upgraded packages, licensing, necessity

conditional.name: Unique reviewer
conditional.brief: anything the change does that no other role covers (config, build/deploy, feature flags, logging, docs). Skip if every part fits another role. Pass it the full role list if spawned.
